This tutorial explains, from scratch, how to download and analyze **methane
(CH4)** from **Sentinel-5P/TROPOMI** over **Brazil**.

::: {.callout-note}
The English translation is **in progress**. The full tutorial is available in
[Português](../pt/index.qmd). Pages translated so far are linked below.
:::

1. [Copernicus account](01-conta-copernicus.qmd)
2. [API links](02-links-api.qmd)

## Requirements

- Python 3.10 or newer;
- a free [Copernicus Data Space](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu) account;
- (optional, for GEE maps) a Google account with Earth Engine access.

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env
```

> The `.env` file stores your credentials and must **never** be committed.
